answer.reason: Admah's king went out to battle in the vale of Siddim, and DEU 29:23 says the LORD overthrew it in his anger.

clauses.english: went to battle with its king against Chedorlaomer and his allies in the vale of Siddim
clauses.quote: the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim

clauses.english: was overthrown by the LORD in his anger and wrath, with Sodom, Gomorrah and Zeboim
clauses.quote: which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath

doubts: GEN 14:8 names Admah only through its king, who joined the battle with the other four kings.
HOS 11:8 only uses Admah as a comparison and is not an event, so it was left out.
GEN 10:19 only gives a border, so it was left out.
